Messages.Author: Mongrel Matt Hirsch
Messages.Body:
During a Bloodlines pre-release, a completely non-BL related question
came up...

My vampire is blocked by vampire A. I play Dawn Operation at basic.

Can the opposing methuselah attempt to block with a different
minion(ie, vampire B), or are his options limited to blocking with
vampire A or not blocking at all?

thanks,

Mongrel

(matt hirsch)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The former. [6.2.2.1]
